* This class is used in a similar way as ServiceManager, except the services registered here
 * are not Binder objects and are only available in the same process.
 *
 * Once all services are converted to the SystemService interface, this class can be absorbed
 * into SystemServiceManager.
 *
 * {@hide}

methods.name: public static T getService(Class<T> type)
methods.comment:
* Returns a local service instance that implements the specified interface.
     *
     * @param type The type of service.
     * @return The service object.

methods.name: public static void addService(Class<T> type, T service)
methods.comment: * Adds a service instance of the specified interface to the global registry of local services.

methods.name: public static void removeServiceForTest(Class<T> type)
methods.comment: * Remove a service instance, must be only used in tests.

methods.name: public static void removeAllServicesForTest()
methods.comment: * Remove all known service instances, must be only used in tests.
